what: Inter-tier rollback bullets disagree on snapshot cadence

suggested_fix: Resolve to one contract (single baseline file pair for entire function vs fresh snapshot before each tier) and delete the contradictory bullet

what: Plan references mirroring run_recovery_waterfall rollback semantics but ship-pr.sh has no such helper on current main

suggested_fix: Make the plan explicitly require calling the landed #2395 rollback primitive by name (or paste its exact contract) before merge; forbid paraphrase-only reinvention

what: Failed-run log capture happens once before the outer while loop
scenario_or_breakage: Each outer vendor retry can feed vendors a stale or misleading --failure-log while local tree and remote CI state diverged
suggested_fix: Re-run gh-run-logs.sh at the start of each outer attempt or document intentional staleness and add a test if refresh is omitted

what: rc=3 described like benign empty capture
scenario_or_breakage: rc=3 from scripts/gh-run-logs.sh:17-19 means run still in progress; file may be non-empty yet unhelpful
suggested_fix: Align plan language with gh-run-logs.sh exit semantics and decide whether rc=3 should short-circuit vendor dispatch or only gate --failure-log

what: Rollback inputs use capture_tracked_dirty_paths and capture_untracked_dirty_paths only
scenario_or_breakage: Submodule or gitlink dirt not reflected like normal files can survive rollback leaving hidden corruption for the next tier
suggested_fix: Extend rollback inputs to match whatever submodule-aware revert #2395 ships or explicitly document submodule exclusion

what: make_repo generic stubs only match launch-cursor-ci.sh|launch-codex-ci.sh for sentinel logging

what: Third argv reuses the live fail_file name for the gh log artifact

suggested_fix: Assign a dedicated readonly variable immediately after gh-run-logs.sh and pass only that into run_ci_fix_vendor
